diag.ADD_RANGE: The ADD jump table cannot address this code.
diag.ADD_REST_DROPPED: The block was modified: the rest of the ADD (unknown bytes) is not rewritten.
diag.BLOCCO_PROTETTO_KNOW_HOW: Know-how protected block: its code is not decoded or shown, only the interface.
diag.DB_GENERE_NON_GESTITO: DB with SSB genre {{genre}} (probably an SFB instance): imported read-only, without members; exported as it is.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: {{fb}} does not hold for its bytes, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_incoherent: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: they do not match {{fb}} of the batch, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_foreign: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: {{fb}} does not come from the import, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}}, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_foreign: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{src}} does not come from the import), and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_incoherent: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{src}} does not match the same batch), and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_import: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} because {{src}} changes with this import, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_import_via: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} changes with this import), and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_changed: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} because {{src}} has changed, and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.DB_NON_CONVERTITO_rebuilt_changed_via: The DB stays a read-only global DB with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} has changed), and as its instance DB it would be locked.
diag.ACCESSO_ASSOLUTO_ISTANZA: Network {{network}}: the interface has changed: absolute accesses to the instance area do not follow the new offsets, check them.
diag.BLOCCO_IMPORTATO_NON_RICODIFICABILE: The imported block cannot be re-encoded after changes: restore it or import it again.
diag.BLOCK_TOO_LARGE: The block is too large for the MC7 format.
diag.CALL_NEEDS_COMPILER: CALL needs the block compiler (not available here).
diag.CALL_NON_VERIFICATO: CALL {{block}} compiled with forms that have no verified real example: {{forms}}.
diag.CALL_RICOSTRUITA_CON_PROGETTO: CALL of {{callee}} rebuilt with the interface of the block in the project: the bytes are the same, but the parameter names are those of {{callee}} in the project, not necessarily those of the original.
diag.CONSTANT_TYPE_LOST: Network modified: {{count}} constants lose their original type byte and use the basic encoding.
diag.DICHIARAZIONE_NON_AMMESSA: {{name}}: a multi-instance (FB or SFB) inside an ARRAY or a STRUCT is not allowed by STEP 7.
diag.DIPENDENZA_ESTRANEA: {{dep}} is a block of the project that does not come from this import: nothing proves the imported bytes were compiled for it. The networks that use it are recompiled from text; an instance DB of that FB stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}} ({{cause}}). The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_foreign: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}}: {{src}} does not come from the import. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_incoherent: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}}: {{src}} does not match the same batch. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_import: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}} because {{src}} changes with this import. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_import_via: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}}: {{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} changes with this import. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_changed: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}} because {{src}} has changed. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DIPENDENZA_RIFATTA_changed_via: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{dep}}: {{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} has changed. The bytes that depend on it no longer hold: the networks that use it are recompiled from text, an instance DB of it stays locked.
diag.DOPPIONE_RILETTO: The bytes equal those of the project block, but with {{dep}} from this import they read differently (rebuilt CALLs or raw instructions): the block is imported again, and the names and comments given in the project are lost.
diag.FB_ISTANZA_NON_TROVATO: FB of the instance DB not found.
diag.FC_ORDINE_PARAMETRI_NON_VERIFICATO: The parameter order of an FC with RET_VAL was verified on a single real block: check the calls.
diag.FORMAL_UNKNOWN: The formal parameter #{{name}} has no known type.
diag.HEADER_FIELD_NOT_ASCII: Header: the field {{field}} contains non-ASCII characters.
diag.HEADER_VERSION: Header: version "{{version}}" is not valid (0.0 to 15.15).
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: it was not compiled for {{fb}} in the project, or nothing proves it. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_foreign: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: {{fb}} in the project does not come from the import, so nothing proves the DB bytes were compiled for it. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_incoherent: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: they do not match {{fb}} imported with it. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}}, which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_foreign: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{src}} does not come from the import), which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_incoherent: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{src}} does not match the same batch), which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_changed: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} because {{src}} has changed, so it no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IDB_INCOERENTE_rebuilt_changed_via: Imported instance DB locked with its bytes: BaaPortal rebuilds the layout of {{fb}} ({{via}} is rebuilt because {{src}} has changed), which no longer matches the DB bytes. Delete it and create it again as an instance of the FB, or import it again together with {{fb}}.
diag.IMPORT_CONTESTO_INCOERENTE: The imported bytes do not match {{dep}} of the same batch (time-stamp conflict): they are not exported as they are (an instance DB stays locked, other blocks are recompiled and lose actual values and raw instructions).
diag.JL_TARGET: The JL label must follow the jump list.
diag.JUMP_ALIGN: The jump target is not aligned.
diag.JUMP_TOO_FAR: The jump is too far ({{words}} words).
diag.LAYOUT_SFB_SCONOSCIUTO: The real instance layout of {{sfb}} is unknown, or the imported blocks give different ones (internal static data, genre of the instance DB): the catalog only has the documented parameters. It must come from a real block, for example a kit read from the PLC.
diag.LINGUAGGIO_NON_COMPILABILE: Language not compilable yet: only AWL.
diag.LOCAL_DATA_TOO_LARGE: The local data exceed the block limit.
diag.P_LOCAL_UNSUPPORTED: A pointer to a local (P##) is not yet supported by the compiler.
diag.RAW_CONTESTO_CAMBIATO: Unchanged network, but its byte context changed after the import: {{detail}}
diag.RAW_HEX_INVALID: Invalid hexadecimal in the raw placeholder.
diag.RAW_IN_CHANGED_NETWORK: Network modified: it contains raw MC7 instructions. Restore the network or remove the raw lines.
diag.RAW_JUMP_ACROSS_CHANGED: A raw MC7 jump crosses a modified network (or the number of networks changed). Restore the networks or remove the raw jumps.
diag.RAW_META_MISMATCH: The raw instructions in the text do not match the metadata: the bytes of the lines are used.
diag.RAW_REMOVED: Network modified: {{count}} raw MC7 instructions are gone and their bytes are not in the code.
diag.TIMESTAMP_RANGE: Date outside the block format range (1984–2163).
diag.UC_BLOCCO_CON_PARAMETRI: UC/CC cannot call {{block}}, which has parameters (IN, OUT or IN_OUT): use CALL.
diag.VALORI_ATTUALI_PERSI: The recompiled DB uses the initial values: the actual values of the original are not kept.
diag.VALORI_INIZIALI_DA_CAMPIONE: Initial values of the SFB internal static data taken from the real block {{sample}}.
